adjacent_proposed_seat_modules.proof: All moving axes are source X; every vertex X is invariant throughout both independent folds. Whole modules have this persistent X separation. Proposed straight parallel modules only, no host row claim.

supplementary_work_service_and_light_che.name: actual_retained_pin_bore_running_clearance
supplementary_work_service_and_light_che.method: Inner sector-face plane distance from actual axis gives minimum finite bore inradius; all actual pin vertices bound pin circumradius. Rigid X-axis rotation preserves these radii, proving positive full-angle clearance. Actual cap inradius exceeds every bore inner corner radius, proving retained geometry with declared unloaded radial gap.
supplementary_work_service_and_light_che.limits: No exact radial contact is asserted in the unloaded centered pose. Designed radial load/capture path is distinct from generic triangle-contact graph; no load, wear, spring, fastener or tolerance-under-load acceptance.

limits: Checks concern independently evaluated static geometry and native ownership, not working hinges, powered lamps, wiring flex, locking, load, photometry, bodies, species, room fit or runtime acceptance.

Closed interval rotation certificates cover t=0 and the first micrometre; adaptive subdivisions alone do not constitute clearance proof. Each accepted interval has a fixed separating plane with analytic full-arc extrema.
Source positive convex-volume and oriented-plane checks support interpreting a positive LP overlap as actual material penetration. Convex envelopes are conservative for separation.

Native export full endpoint boxes are checked with all triangles and winding containment; native ownership and complete group vertex agreement bind source motion geometry. Native controls contain only exported terminal states; runtime control is absent.
